title: Otto Skorzeny's ratline used Knights of Malta passports

tellings.quote: Yeah. Auto Scorzani, who ran the rat line, you know, of of smuggling them all out of there. And they were knights of Malta passports.

plain: The lawyer Dan Sheehan says that Otto Skorzeny, a Nazi commando officer, ran the "rat line," the secret escape route that smuggled Nazis out of Europe after the Second World War, and that the people moved along it carried passports from the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knights. Sheehan passes this on as something he learned from others, and it would tie a respected religious order to the escape of Nazis.
